evidence.explanation: JS uses ThemeroomSelection constructor/set/get/bounds and an inline full-map clear; these C-only selection call edges are alternate implementations in the tested replacement domain.
evidence.proof: 30 comparisons: whole map, region, explicit rectangle, sparse absolute selection and empty selection × chances 0/50/100 × two seeds. Exact C lspo_replace_terrain and seven selection helper bodies match the public JS des.replace_terrain terrain coordinates and checked shared RNG tape. Typed table, default frame, and terrain-write adapters are explicit; no mapfragment, parser, lighting/metadata, relative frame composition or finalization claim.
evidence.control: Chance zero retains the input map but still consumes a draw per eligible floor; empty selection consumes none. Chance 100 changes all eligible floors. Region and explicit bounds agree; sparse selection filters membership.
